# Measured arm runtimes

Wall time for every gate arm on one host, one run each. This file is the
repository's single home for measured numbers: prose elsewhere links here
instead of copying a number. Refresh it with `./run.sh measure`; verify that
its rows and prose were not hand-edited with `./run.sh measure --check`.

| Arm | Command | Wall time (s) | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docs` | `./run.sh docs` | 0.59 | ok |
| `gnn` | `./run.sh gnn` | 0.72 | ok |
| `setup` | `./run.sh setup` | 3.05 | ok (re-install of a provisioned environment) |
| `all` | `./run.sh all` | 1.31 | ok |

One run of each arm, no warm-up. The comment above records when and on which host.

The arms above sum to 4.35 s. `./run.sh all` runs `docs` and `gnn`
back to back; `setup` is provisioning, not a check.

`setup` installs
[`../.github/requirements-gate.txt`](../.github/requirements-gate.txt) and the
GNN parser pinned in [`../.github/gnn-pin.json`](../.github/gnn-pin.json). It
needs network access, and the `docs` arm never depends on it.

See [`run-guide.md`](run-guide.md) for what each arm checks.
